entries.note: The claim attributes a private intention to Anthropic: trying to frighten people. Its separate assertion about what the blog demonstrated is publicly checkable.

entries.test: Public technical reports and controlled comparisons isolating scaling, harnesses, and symbolic tools would show which interventions produced the reported coding gains and whether the tools are neurosymbolic.
entries.note: The language of a 'victory' expresses a substantive attribution of the gains to particular technical methods.

entries.test: Marcus's public statements and technical evidence about systems supplementing deep learning with neurosymbolic methods would establish whether his account of his earlier claims and their subsequent realization is accurate.
entries.note: This concerns his public claims, rather than an inaccessible private belief, and asserts that the predicted supplementation has already occurred.
